verdict.rationale: Claude is driven through an extensively documented public API. The docs cover the Messages API, a token-counting endpoint, the `GET /v1/models` catalog, the Batches API, streaming, versioning guarantees, rate limits, Admin and Usage APIs, official SDKs in seven languages, an `ant` CLI, and .md mirrors of the full API reference linked from llms.txt. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of API integration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
